costs.caveat: Conservative quoted spread plus additional reference reserve. This does not claim actual account fees, slippage, capacity, funding or exchange execution.
costs.one_x: net_bps = weighted quote gross_bps - full frozen reference reserve
costs.profile: Observed bid/ask gross minus additional frozen full reference reserve
costs.reference: Exact pinned fresh config cost_snapshot, validated through fresh producer read_config.
costs.stress_two_x: stress2x_net_bps = weighted quote gross_bps - 2 * full frozen reference reserve

decision_binding.entry: First new PUBLIC depth request strictly after actual strategy emission/decision, with receipt and raw body saved. No extra 15m/30m fill boundary delay and no past OHLC/open fills.
decision_binding.execution_size: Unit gross research notional; no account allocation or proven executable size.
decision_binding.stale_signal: Explicit producer MISSED_SUPERSEDED_DECISION_OBSERVATION_ONLY is rejected. Latest common available observed canonical decision close is rechecked after quote retrieval before new entry. Missing current context holds pending.

fills.exit: Hard stop, frozen TP, frozen partial TP, max elapsed hold and causal lifecycle trigger decision first; fill only from a later actual quote request. Never fill from trigger candle or historical price.
fills.first_partial_entry_bar: Quote stops/TP/partials/MFE are active immediately. Frozen callbacks start at first full post-entry canonical bar. Native ST and three parent controls bridge ATR/band/close/segment feature state through actual completed partial candle without lifecycle fills or false gap exits. Parent peak/trail geometry uses observed quote MFE only.
fills.gaps: Unresolved quote/candle/segment/native-state gaps retain open position under HOLD; no fabricated close, terminal mark or released owner.
fills.mfe_mae: Observed post-entry liquidation-side quotes only, including final exit quote. No first partial entry-bar high/low credit.
fills.outcome_clock: Exit timestamp is actual quote receipt; outcome availability is actual paper processing clock.
fills.pair: Every leg must have a new request after decision. Quote receipt skew bounded by frozen config. Unit-gross weighted leg returns and weighted reference cost counted once.
fills.partial: Frozen signal partial R/fraction only, at most once, strictly less than full exposure. OHLC partial hints never fill or realize economics.
fills.stop_update: Causal completed-bar callback activates a tightened stop at actual processing availability. It can trigger only on later observed quote, then fills on another later quote.

persistence.on_failure: HOLD_OBSERVED_PAPER_INTEGRITY; no ledger deletion or synthetic recovery
persistence.projections: paper_trades.jsonl and paper_events.jsonl are repairable hash-chain projections of committed STATE.
persistence.state: Atomic hash-bound STATE.json is authoritative; source cursors and close ledger commit together. Same-source prefix and per-source hash profile must match on restart.
persistence.writer: fcntl exclusive nonblocking paper.lock covers loop

code_pins.path: Absolute actual source path, must include exact executing paper source path

required_config.fresh_start_ms: Positive future UTC milliseconds; >= pinned fresh producer start; initialize before this time.

runtime_binding: Fresh FREEZE must match pinned forward config SHA; every Fresh wrapper must match configured freeze SHA. Micro FREEZE identity and producer/decision code hashes are checked. Strategies/imports are loaded from pinned forward campaign contract.
scheduling: Loop approximately every 30 seconds; service installation/start belongs to root after final freeze. No service installed by implementation agent.

source.archive: Exact response body, HTTP status, source URL, query, requested/received timestamps and SHA receipt. Best nonzero displayed bid/ask only; malformed/crossed books fail closed.
source.coverage: Sparse observed quote path; missing ticks and complete intrabar execution path are not claimed.
source.freshness: Required config-bound max_quote_request_ms, max_pair_skew_ms and max_quote_gap_ms. These are operational sampling/clock limits, not optimized strategy thresholds.

validation.independent_review: Break agent reviewed source integration and independently ran bounded paper suite; exact-hash receipt follows
